title: Graduate Software Engineer
content: <h3>About Elwood Robotics</h3><p>Elwood Robotics builds the software that plans and checks warehouse robot fleets for grocery and parcel companies across the UK and Ireland. Our platform schedules 4,000 robots a night and our customers rely on it to ship on time.</p><h3>What you'll do</h3><ul><li>Build and run Python services that plan robot routes across a warehouse floor</li><li>Design PostgreSQL schemas for telemetry that arrives at 20,000 events a second</li><li>Write tests in pytest and review your colleagues' pull requests every day</li><li>Work with operations engineers on site to understand what a failed pick costs</li><li>Own a service from the design document to the on-call rota, with support</li></ul><h3>What we're looking for</h3><ul><li>A degree in computer science, engineering or a related subject, or equivalent experience</li><li>Experience building REST APIs in Python, Go or a similar language</li><li>Comfort with SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL</li><li>Clear written English: we decide most things in short design documents</li><li>The right to work in the UK (we are unable to sponsor visas for this role)</li></ul><h3>What we offer</h3><ul><li>A salary of £38,000 to £45,000 depending on experience</li><li>25 days of holiday plus bank holidays</li><li>Hybrid working from our Manchester office two days a week</li></ul>
